title: trainnet
summary: Report unsupported full neural-network training with a deterministic error.
description: `trainnet` is registered so modern Deep Learning Toolbox scripts fail with a clear RunMat diagnostic instead of an undefined-builtin error.
behaviors: The builtin returns a deterministic unsupported-training error without materializing training inputs.
Full optimizer, loss, autodiff, datastore, GPU execution, and trained-network object semantics remain in the Deep Learning training slice.

examples.input: net = trainnet(X, Y, net, lossFcn, options)
examples.output: RunMat reports that training infrastructure is not yet implemented.

gpu_residency: Training execution is not implemented in this slice; GPU training kernels remain future work.
